column2: MIPI CSI2 DPHY Lanes Test
column5: Validates MIPI CSI-2 D-PHY lane configuration by iterating through lane counts (4 to 1) and verifying data reception via DMA for each lane configuration. Tests control packet and data packet transfers across all lane configurations.
column7: CSI-2 subsystem powered on; D-PHY in stop state; DMA engine available; GDMA path configured (GDMA0/1/2/3)
column8:
Step 1: Enable CSI-2 interrupts by reading INT_ST_MAIN and writing interrupt mask registers
Step 2: Write virtual channel register with VC_ID configuration
Step 3: Enable control data transfer by writing control_data register
Step 4: Initialize SNPS D-PHY (snps_phy_init)
Step 5: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE register until value equals 0x1000F (all lanes + clock in stop state)
Step 6: Loop lane_num from 3 down to 0:
  Step 6a: Write N_LANES register with lane_num
  Step 6b: Write 0xa0243ffc with (lane_num+1) to trigger CSI2 sequence
  Step 6c: For each control packet:
    - Enable DMA interrupt (INTEN offset 0x20 = 0x3)
    - Preload DMA ch0 transfer instructions
    - Execute DMAGO for ch0
    - Poll DMA INTMIS (offset 0x28) for bit[0] = 1
    - Clear DMA interrupt (INTCLR offset 0x2C = 0x1)
    - Read control data from 0xE6001000
    - If data_type > 0xF: preload DMA ch1 for data transfer
    - Execute DMAGO for ch1
    - Poll DMA INTMIS for bit[1] = 1
    - Clear DMA interrupt (INTCLR = 0x2)
Step 7: Call finish(0)

column2: MIPI CSI2 Test Pattern Generator
column5: Validates MIPI CSI-2 internal test pattern generator (PG) functionality. Configures PG with specific VRES/HRES/data type, enables it, transfers received data via DMA, and verifies DMA completion. Tests the complete data path from PG through CSI-2 controller to DMA.
column7: CSI-2 subsystem powered on; D-PHY in stop state; DMA engine available; GDMA path configured
column8:
Step 1: Configure virtual channel register with VC_ID mapping
Step 2: Disable control data transfer (control_data = 0)
Step 3: Enable CSI-2 and DMA subsystem interrupts
Step 4: Initialize SNPS D-PHY (snps_phy_init)
Step 5: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE register until value equals 0x1000F
Step 6: Configure DMA higher-order address bits:
  - Write dma_m0_addr_ar_ch0_data = 0x100
  - Write dma_m0_addr_ar_ch0_Instruction = 0x0
  - Write dma_m0_addr_aw_ch0_data = 0x0
  - Write dma_m0_addr_aw_ch0_Instruction = 0x0
Step 7: Enable fracdiv output (MIZAR_MIPI_CSI2_RB_REG_BASE + 0xF4 = 0x1)
Step 8: Preload DMA ch0 transfer instructions for data transfer
Step 9: Execute DMAGO for ch0
Step 10: Configure Pattern Generator:
  - Write PPI_PG_PATTERN_VRES = 0x10 (16 lines)
  - Write PPI_PG_PATTERN_HRES = 0x70140 (pkt2pkt_time=7, hres=320)
  - Write PPI_PG_CONFIG = 0xE401 (vc=3, datatype=0x24, pattern=1)
  - Write PPI_PG_ENABLE = 1
Step 11: Wait 100 cycles
Step 12: Disable Pattern Generator (PPI_PG_ENABLE = 0)
Step 13: Poll DMA INTMIS for bit[0] = 1 (transfer complete)
Step 14: Wait 10000 cycles
Step 15: Call finish(0)
